description.value: The Richmond Ice Centre is a City of Richmond-operated indoor ice facility offering public skating and ice hockey year-round. Situated in Richmond, BC, it serves both recreational skaters and competitive hockey players as a municipally run arena. Touring cyclists passing through Richmond could visit as a recreational stop or spectator attraction.
